messages:
laura: alertinghigh apiserver 5xx rate in eu-north1 since ~14:12UTC, leader election churn on controller-manager.
vikram: seeing leader flips every 20-30s, etcd follower RTTs jump to ~300ms intermittently. GPU attach jobs backing up in eu-north1.
sre-oncall: logs show repeated dial timeouts from apiserver -> etcd. can anyone confirm recent networking changes?
netbot: automated note: NAT gateway scaling event completed at 14:10UTC; config: ephemeral SNAT pools enabled for 60s.
ops-maria: I pushed a change to natgw pool sizing to improve throughput at 14:09, hoping to reduce conn timeouts. rolling back now.
laura: copy. during the spike apiserver returned 503s and controller-manager leader lost repeatedly, here's a snippet:

```
E0319 14:13:02.201 server.go:123] proxy error: dial tcp 10.1.12.45:2379: i/o timeout
I0319 14:13:22.407 leaderelection.go:88] failed to acquire lease: context deadline exceeded
```

tom: etcd endpoint ping from controlplane nodes:

```
# curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 http://10.1.12.45:2379/v2/stats/leader | jq '.commitIndex'
# result delayed and some nodes timed out
```

sre-oncall: rolling a short mitigation: enabling SNAT persistent mapping (sticky) on the natgw and disabling the ephemeral pool expansion. applying now.
netbot: natgw: sticky-snat flag toggled by @sre-oncall at 14:22UTC.
vikram: after sticky SNAT apiserver->etcd RTTs look stable ~20ms, leader holds. still seeing a backlog of GPU attach tasks; autoscaler kept spinning up because attach fails were retried.
ops-maria: temporarily pausing eu-north1 GPU onboarding and redirecting new onboarding jobs to us-east1 via provisioning policy change.

```
# curl -X POST https://infra-api/provisioning/route -d '{"region_from":"eu-north1","region_to":"us-east1","filter":"onboarding=true"}'
```

laura: note: cost for the hour increased ~+18% due to cross-region runs, logged in billing.
infra-bot: deployment: rolled back natgw sizing change by ops-maria at 14:24 UTC :white_check_mark:.

sre-oncall: also bumped controller-manager leader election retry interval to 15s to reduce flapping while netfix propagates. will revert after validation.
vikram: added a scheduler soft-backoff for GPU attach retries to avoid thundering: backoff=20s for first 3 retries.

```
# kubectl -n kube-system patch cm gpu-autoscaler --patch '{"data":{"attach_retry_backoff":"20s"}}'
```

tom: collecting perf graphs and will attach to INC-2024. please paste apiserver latency, etcd leader changes, natgw error counters.
laura: creating postmortem ticket INC-2024 and assigning eng-sre + networking, tagging @oncall. keep sticky SNAT until staging verifies fix.
sre-oncall: monitoring window 60m. if stable for 30m we'll start re-enabling eu-north onboarding gradually. thanks all.
